alt: This customizable Microsoft Word Government Tort Claim Template, compliant with California Government Code §§ 905 and 910, is designed for claims under a $10,000 threshold and is modeled on active forensic filings against L.A. Care Health Plan.
summary: This customizable Microsoft Word Government Tort Claim Template, compliant with California Government Code §§ 905 and 910, is designed for claims under a $10,000 threshold and is modeled on active forensic filings against L.A. Care Health Plan.
full_text: Customizable Microsoft Word Government Tort Claim Template pursuant to California Government Code §§ 905 and 910. Provides compliant fields for claimant information, notice address, date, place, circumstances of incident, description of loss/damages (under $10,000 threshold), name of public employees responsible, and signature blocks. Modeled on active forensic filings against L.A. Care Health Plan.
